title: AI DIME Portfolio Screenshot Importer & AI Trade Slip Parser (Single-Agent Mode)
objective: Implement AI-powered portfolio import from DIME screenshot captures (up to 5 images, extracting ticker, market value, unrealized P/L and computing cost basis with verification modal and selective upsert) and AI-powered trade slip parser (auto-detecting Buy/Sell, ticker, shares, price, and auto-filling trade modal with cash link to investment_stock).
user_story: As an active investor, I want to import my stock holdings by uploading DIME screenshot captures and record buy/sell trades from slips via AI so that I do not need to enter numbers manually.
acceptance_criteria: Add '📷 นำเข้าพอร์ตจากรูป/สลิป' button in Portfolio view
Portfolio Import Modal matches user DIME screenshot specification (guidance banners, profit/loss mode check, max 5 images, non-destructive upsert)
AI Parsing logic extracts Ticker, Market Value, Unrealized P/L, Unrealized P/L %, and derives Cost Basis and Average Cost
Verification modal allows users to review, edit, and select which extracted stock holdings to save before committing
Upsert logic updates matching stocks, adds new ones, and preserves untouched existing stocks
Trade slip parser extracts Buy/Sell action, ticker, quantity, price, and auto-fills trade modal with fund jar link
All unit and integration tests pass 100% with zero regressions
